objective: Store genuine raw downloaded fixture bytes for filesystem-default tests; opt-in portable refresh.

non_goals: No hooks, credentials, profiles, cron, GitHub writes or test-contract migration
acceptance_and_failure_policy: Verify genuine capture bytes/hash/provenance and failure-body separation
Run required unit/full/build/MCP on exact frozen candidate in fresh credential-free sandbox
Unchanged current website schema/data assertion failures may remain red for this fixture-storage PR only
Missing captures remain explicit gaps; introduced packaging/code regression is not waived
Independent fixture-only review and parent publication still required; no claim of all-green or normal PR_READY

capture_gaps.semantics: Fresh alternative vacancy/board captures are not historical expected titles or entities; paths preserved without assertions changed.

stop_limits.boundaries: Public declared/necessary related hosts only; never credentials/private/control endpoints; stop at budget or remaining unavailable sources.
